items.label: Soft and Breathable
items.value: The back cushion is made of high-density and durable memory foam to provide you with proper support and long-lasting comfort. The 4D air-cooled mesh on the lumbar pillow pillowcase provides high-density breathability to keep your back cool and airy.

items.label: Pain Relief
items.value: The kasney memory foam lumbar pillow is ergonomically designed to effectively fill the gap between your back and the chair/bed, and the reboundable memory foam perfectly fits the curve of the human lumbar spine, providing cushioning, support, and comfort for your lower back, whether you're sitting or lying down.

items.label: Multifunctional Lumbar Pillow
items.value: Our lumbar pillow provides you with a comfortable area anytime, anywhere, it provides enough back support and good sedentary experience for office workers, long-term bed-ridden patients and long-distance drivers to relieve back pain. Perfect for bed and office chairs, car seats, sofas, wheelchairs, recliners and other types of chairs.

items.label: Easy To Wash
items.value: For hygienic reasons, the kasney lumbar support pillow features an invisible zip, so you can always separate the pillow insert from the pillowcase and take the pillowcase to the wash. Remember, memory foam pillow inserts cannot be washed! The pillow insert only needs to be left to air out.

items.label: Warm Tip
items.value: For best appearance and support, please unpack and wait 24 hours before starting to use. Please note that the memory foam may have different firmness levels at various temperatures. It tends to be firmer in colder conditions and softer in warmer environments. This is a normal occurrence and does not affect its usability.

items.value: we value your experience. If you encounter any problems during use, please feel free to contact us.
